season.evidence: Stored Jul-Oct (best late Jul-Sep). Web search (Mountaineers Union and Jove Peaks, WTA, Wenatchee Outdoors): summer/fall is a non-technical scramble; Smithbrook Road snow-covered early summer; an Oct 2025 WTA report found muddy trail and no snow to Union Gap. The peak's histogram is dominated by Dec-Apr ski ascents.

notes: All six harvested tracks are Jan-Mar winter ascents (the starts are ~3.6 km from our Smithbrook trailhead pin because they begin at the Highway 2 pullout and road-walk). None is in or near the Jul-Oct window, so no track and no facts. The only warm-season logged ascents (3 each in Jun-Sep) have no GPX in the harvest.
